args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in production. An SRE rollback was executed to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified successful in all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** — found that **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production (the current v2.3.1 deploy was unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified successful in every region.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary of the failure and rollback actions. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 had previously been unhealthy, so a rollback (not a new deploy of an unproven version) was appropriate and required no change-manager approval. Root cause investigation of v2.3.1 is still pending.
